The '''CX-3.1 hologram recorder''' was a model of high-density [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorder]] manufactured by [[Corellidyne Visuals]]. The unit had a data intake capability that was a thousand times greater than other holorecorders on the market, allowing it to perfectly replicate the movement and appearance of a recorded subject. The [[CQ-3.9x holographic image disguiser]] relied on a CX-3.1 hologram recorder to record the image of a person or object to be projected.<ref name="EGWT" />
